blocks.text: still, yet, already: vaqt va kutish

Uchala so'z ham vaqt haqida, aniqrog'i — biror narsa **kutganimizdek**, **kechroq** yoki **ertaroq** bo'lgani haqida. **still** — holat **davom etyapti**, hali tugamagan («hali ham», «hamon»). **yet** — kutilgan narsa **hali bo'lmadi** (inkor va savolda). **already** — narsa **kutganimizdan oldin** bo'lib bo'ldi («allaqachon»). O'zbekchada bu ma'nolar ko'pincha fe'l shakli bilan beriladi: «yeb **bo'ldim**» (already), «hali **yemadim**» (not yet), «hali ham **yeyapti**» (still).

rows: It's **still** raining. — Hali ham yomg'ir yog'yapti.
fe'ldan oldin, be va have dan keyin

blocks.text: **still** biror holat yoki harakat **hali tugamaganini**, ba'zan kutilganidan uzoq davom etayotganini bildiradi. Uning o'rni — always kabi (94-dars): oddiy fe'ldan **oldin** (I **still** live with my parents), be dan **keyin** (She's **still** at work), yordamchi fe'ldan keyin (I can **still** remember; They're **still** waiting).

items.text: My grandfather **still** works in his garden every day.
items.translation: Bobom **hali ham** har kuni bog'ida ishlaydi.

items.text: I can **still** hear the music from next door.

blocks.text: Inkor gapda **still** inkor yordamchi fe'ldan **oldin** turadi: I **still** haven't finished. He **still** doesn't understand. Bu shakl sabrsizlik yoki ajablanishni bildiradi: «**hali ham** tugatmadim» — ancha vaqt o'tdi, lekin natija yo'q. Taqqoslang: I haven't finished **yet** — oddiy xabar; I **still** haven't finished — kuchliroq, «hamon tugatolmayapman».
yet — inkor va savolda, gap oxirida

**yet** faqat **inkor** va **savol** gaplarda ishlatiladi va odatda gapning **oxirida** turadi. Britaniya inglizchasida u ko'pincha Present Perfect bilan keladi (16-dars): I haven't finished **yet** — Hali tugatmadim. Have you finished **yet**? — Tugatdingizmi? (o'zbekchada savolda alohida so'z shart emas). Qisqa javob: **Not yet.** — Hali yo'q. Boshqa zamonlar bilan ham bo'ladi: I don't know **yet** — hali bilmayman; Is dinner ready **yet**? — Kechki ovqat tayyor bo'ldimi?

items.text: Has Madina called you **yet**? — No, not **yet**.

blocks.text: **already** biror narsa **kutilganidan oldin** yoki biz o'ylagandan erta bo'lganini bildiradi. O'rni — gap o'rtasida: have dan keyin (I've **already** paid), be dan keyin (She's **already** here), oddiy fe'ldan oldin (He **already** knows). O'zbekchada «allaqachon» yoki fe'l shakli: «to'lab **qo'ydim**», «bilib **bo'lgan**». Savolda **already** ajablanishni bildiradi va gap oxirida ham kela oladi: Are you leaving **already**? — Shu zahoti ketyapsizmi?

items.text: Don't call Tom — I've **already** told him.
items.translation: Tomga qo'ng'iroq qilmang — men unga **allaqachon** aytdim.

items.text: It's only March, but it's **already** warm.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I yet haven't finished.» → **I haven't finished yet.** (yet — oxirida); «I haven't finished still.» → **I still haven't finished.** (still — inkordan oldin); «She is at work still.» → **She's still at work.**; «I still not understand.» → **I still don't understand.**; «Already I have eaten.» → **I've already eaten.**; tasdiq gapda yet: «I have finished yet.» → **I have already finished.**
Eslab qolish: **still** — hali **davom etyapti**; **yet** — **kutyapmiz**, hali bo'lmadi (gap oxirida, faqat inkor va savolda); **already** — **kutganimizdan oldin** bo'ldi.

Bog'lanish: just / already / yet Present Perfect bilan — 16-dars; gap o'rtasidagi so'zlarning o'rni — 94-dars. Amerika inglizchasida Past Simple bilan ham aytiladi: Did you eat **yet**? Britaniyada: Have you eaten **yet**?

examples.title: **still**: it's still raining
examples.description: **still** — holat davom etyapti, hali tugamagan: «hali ham», «hamon». O'rni: oddiy fe'ldan oldin, be dan keyin.

sentences.text: It's **still** raining, so take an umbrella.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **hali ham** yog'yapti, soyabon olib oling.

sentences.text: My grandparents **still** live in the same village.
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvim **hali ham** o'sha qishloqda yashashadi.

sentences.text: Is Aziz **still** at work? It's nine o'clock!
sentences.translation: Aziz **hali ham** ishdami? Soat to'qqiz bo'ldi-ku!

sentences.text: I **still** remember my first teacher's name.
sentences.translation: Birinchi o'qituvchimning ismini **hali ham** eslayman.

sentences.text: Twenty years later, they're **still** best friends.
sentences.translation: Yigirma yil o'tsa ham ular **hamon** eng yaqin do'st.

sentences.text: The baby is **still** asleep, so please be quiet.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **hali ham** uxlayapti, iltimos, jim bo'ling.

sentences.text: Do you **still** play the piano? — Yes, every day.
sentences.translation: **Hali ham** pianino chalasizmi? — Ha, har kuni.

sentences.text: Madina is **still** working on her report.
sentences.translation: Madina **hali ham** hisoboti ustida ishlayapti.

sentences.text: Dad is sixty-five, but he **still** goes to work every day.
sentences.translation: Dadam oltmish besh yoshda, lekin **hali ham** har kuni ishga boradi.

sentences.text: After all these years, Samarkand is **still** my favourite city.
sentences.translation: Shuncha yillardan keyin ham Samarqand **hamon** mening eng sevimli shahrim.

examples.title: **still** + negative: I **still** haven't ...
examples.description: Inkorda **still** yordamchi fe'ldan oldin: I **still** haven't, he **still** doesn't. Ma'nosi — sabrsizlik: «hali ham ...-madi», «hamon ...-maydi».

sentences.text: I **still** haven't finished my essay, and it's due tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Inshoni **hali ham** tugatmadim, ertaga topshirish kerak.

sentences.text: Bekzod **still** doesn't understand the rules of cricket.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kriket qoidalarini **hali ham** tushunmaydi.

sentences.text: It's ten o'clock, and Emma **still** isn't here.
sentences.translation: Soat o'n bo'ldi, Emma esa **hali ham** yo'q.

sentences.text: We **still** haven't heard from the bank about the loan.
sentences.translation: Kredit bo'yicha bankdan **hali ham** javob olmadik.

sentences.text: My little brother **still** can't swim, but he's learning.
sentences.translation: Ukam **hali ham** suza olmaydi, lekin o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: The letter **still** hasn't arrived — maybe it's lost.
sentences.translation: Xat **hali ham** kelmadi — balki yo'qolgandir.

sentences.text: Sarah **still** hasn't answered my message from Monday.
sentences.translation: Sara dushanbadagi xabarimga **hali ham** javob bermadi.

sentences.text: Even after three lessons, I **still** don't know how to use this program.
sentences.translation: Uch darsdan keyin ham bu dasturdan qanday foydalanishni **hali ham** bilmayman.

sentences.text: The workers **still** haven't fixed the lift, so we're using the stairs.
sentences.translation: Ishchilar liftni **hali ham** tuzatishmadi, shuning uchun zinadan chiqib-tushyapmiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **still** doesn't eat meat, even at weddings.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **hali ham** go'sht yemaydi, hatto to'ylarda ham.

examples.title: Negative + **yet**: I haven't ... **yet**
examples.description: **yet** inkor gapda, gap oxirida: I haven't had lunch **yet** — «hali tushlik qilmadim». Kutilgan narsa hali bo'lmadi.

sentences.text: I haven't had lunch **yet**.
sentences.translation: **Hali** tushlik qilmadim.

sentences.text: The guests haven't arrived **yet**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar **hali** kelishmadi.

sentences.text: Madina hasn't decided which university to choose **yet**.
sentences.translation: Madina qaysi universitetni tanlashni **hali** hal qilmadi.

sentences.text: Don't eat the cake — it isn't ready **yet**.
sentences.translation: Tortni yemang — u **hali** tayyor emas.

sentences.text: We've booked the hotel, but we haven't bought the tickets **yet**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonani band qildik, lekin chiptalarni **hali** olmadik.

sentences.text: Tom has been in Tashkent for a week, but he hasn't seen Chorsu Bazaar **yet**.
sentences.translation: Tom bir haftadan beri Toshkentda, lekin Chorsu bozorini **hali** ko'rmadi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I don't know the answer **yet**. I'll call you tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, javobni **hali** bilmayman. Ertaga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

sentences.text: Our new neighbours haven't introduced themselves **yet**.
sentences.translation: Yangi qo'shnilarimiz **hali** o'zlarini tanishtirishmadi.

sentences.text: The doctor hasn't got my test results **yet**.
sentences.translation: Shifokor tahlil natijalarimni **hali** olmadi.

sentences.text: My son is two, and he can't read **yet**, but he knows all the letters.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim ikki yoshda, **hali** o'qiy olmaydi, lekin hamma harflarni biladi.

examples.title: Questions with **yet**: Have you ... **yet**?
examples.description: Savolda **yet** — gap oxirida: Have you finished **yet**? — «Tugatdingizmi?». O'zbekchada alohida so'z kerak emas. Qisqa javob: **Not yet.** — «Hali yo'q».

sentences.text: Have you finished your homework **yet**? — Not **yet**.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifangizni **tugatdingizmi**? — **Hali yo'q**.

sentences.text: Has the film started **yet**? — Yes, it has. Hurry up!
sentences.translation: Film **boshlandimi**? — Ha, boshlandi. Tezroq!

sentences.text: Is dinner ready **yet**? I'm starving!
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat **tayyor bo'ldimi**? Qornim juda ochdi!

sentences.text: Our new manager starts today. Have you met him **yet**?
sentences.translation: Yangi menejerimiz bugun ishga tushdi. U bilan **tanishdingizmi**?

sentences.text: Has Aziz paid for the tickets **yet**? — I don't think so.
sentences.translation: Aziz chiptalar uchun pul **to'ladimi**? — To'lamagan bo'lsa kerak.

sentences.text: Do you know your exam results **yet**? — No, we'll get them on Friday.
sentences.translation: Imtihon natijalaringizni **bildingizmi**? — Yo'q, juma kuni bilamiz.

sentences.text: Have the children gone to bed **yet**? — Yes, they're asleep.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **yotishdimi**? — Ha, uxlab qolishdi.

sentences.text: Are you ready **yet**? The taxi is waiting!
sentences.translation: **Tayyormisiz**? Taksi kutib turibdi!

sentences.text: Has Sarah found a new job **yet**? — Yes, she starts on Monday.
sentences.translation: Sara yangi ish **topdimi**? — Ha, dushanbadan boshlaydi.

sentences.text: The book I lent you — have you read it **yet**? — I'm halfway through.
sentences.translation: Men bergan kitob — uni **o'qib chiqdingizmi**? — Yarmiga yetdim.

examples.title: **already**: sooner than expected
examples.description: **already** — kutganimizdan oldin bo'ldi: «allaqachon», «-b bo'ldi», «-b qo'ydi». O'rni: have va be dan keyin, oddiy fe'ldan oldin.

sentences.text: I've **already** paid for dinner, so put your wallet away.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat uchun **allaqachon** to'lab qo'ydim, hamyoningizni olib qo'ying.

sentences.text: It's **already** eleven — we should go home.
sentences.translation: Soat **allaqachon** o'n bir bo'ldi — uyga ketishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: Madina has **already** booked our tickets to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Madina Buxoroga chiptalarimizni **allaqachon** band qilib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: You don't need to tell Tom. He **already** knows.
sentences.translation: Tomga aytishingiz shart emas. U **allaqachon** biladi.

sentences.text: When we arrived at the station, the train was **already** there.
sentences.translation: Vokzalga yetib kelganimizda, poyezd **allaqachon** turgan edi.

sentences.text: Don't buy any bread — I've **already** bought some.
sentences.translation: Non olmang — men **allaqachon** olib qo'ydim.

sentences.text: My son is only five, but he can **already** read.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim bor-yo'g'i besh yoshda, lekin **hozirdanoq** o'qiy oladi.

sentences.text: It's only October, but the shops are **already** selling New Year decorations.
sentences.translation: Hali oktyabr, do'konlar esa **allaqachon** yangi yil bezaklarini sotyapti.

sentences.text: Bekzod has only worked here for a month, but he's **already** a team leader.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bu yerda bor-yo'g'i bir oydan beri ishlaydi, lekin **allaqachon** guruh rahbari.

sentences.text: Are you leaving **already**? You've only just arrived!
sentences.translation: **Shu zahoti** ketyapsizmi? Hozirgina keldingiz-ku!

examples.title: **yet**? — **already**: questions and answers
examples.description: Savolda **yet**, javobda **already** yoki **not yet**. Savol → javob juftliklari; oxirgisida **still** ham.

sentences.text: Have you done the shopping **yet**? — Yes, I've **already** done it.
sentences.translation: **Xarid qildingizmi**? — Ha, **allaqachon** qilib bo'ldim.

sentences.text: Has the plane landed **yet**? — Yes, it's **already** at the gate.
sentences.translation: Samolyot **qo'ndimi**? — Ha, u **allaqachon** terminal yonida turibdi.

sentences.text: Have you told your parents **yet**? — No, not **yet**. I'm scared!
sentences.translation: Ota-onangizga **aytdingizmi**? — Yo'q, **hali** aytmadim. Qo'rqyapman!

sentences.text: Is Emma here **yet**? — Yes, she's **already** in the meeting room.
sentences.translation: Emma **keldimi**? — Ha, u **allaqachon** majlis xonasida.

sentences.text: Shall I wash the dishes? — No need, Aziz has **already** washed them.
sentences.translation: Idishlarni yuvaymi? — Shart emas, Aziz ularni **allaqachon** yuvib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Has the post come **yet**? — Not **yet**; it usually comes at eleven.
sentences.translation: Pochta **keldimi**? — **Hali** yo'q, u odatda soat o'n birda keladi.

sentences.text: Do you want to see the new Bond film? — I've **already** seen it twice!
sentences.translation: Yangi Bond filmini ko'rishni xohlaysizmi? — Men uni **allaqachon** ikki marta ko'rganman!

sentences.text: Wow, have you finished **already**? That was quick!
sentences.translation: Voy, **shu zahoti** tugatdingizmi? Tez bo'ldi-ku!

sentences.text: Are the results online **yet**? — Yes, I've **already** checked mine.
sentences.translation: Natijalar internetga **chiqdimi**? — Ha, men o'zimnikini **allaqachon** ko'rib chiqdim.

sentences.text: Is Bekzod **still** asleep? — No, he's **already** gone to the gym.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **hali ham** uxlayaptimi? — Yo'q, u **allaqachon** sport zaliga ketgan.

examples.title: **still**, **yet** and **already** together
examples.description: Uchala so'z bitta gapda: biri hali davom etyapti (**still**), biri bo'lib bo'ldi (**already**), biri hali bo'lmadi (**yet**).

sentences.text: It's **still** dark outside, but Grandad is **already** up.
sentences.translation: Tashqari **hali ham** qorong'i, lekin bobom **allaqachon** turib olgan.

sentences.text: I've **already** cleaned the kitchen, but I haven't started the bathroom **yet**.
sentences.translation: Oshxonani **allaqachon** tozaladim, lekin vannaxonani **hali** boshlamadim.

sentences.text: Aziz is **still** at university, but his brother **already** has a job.
sentences.translation: Aziz **hali** universitetda o'qiydi, akasi esa **allaqachon** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: The rain has stopped, but the roads are **still** wet.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir to'xtadi, lekin yo'llar **hali ham** ho'l.

sentences.text: We've **already** packed our bags, but we **still** haven't found the passports!
sentences.translation: Sumkalarimizni **allaqachon** yig'ib bo'ldik, lekin pasportlarni **hali ham** topmadik!

sentences.text: Is Lola **still** living in London, or has she **already** moved back to Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Lola **hali ham** Londonda yashayaptimi yoki Toshkentga **allaqachon** qaytib keldimi?

sentences.text: My tea is **still** too hot to drink.
sentences.translation: Choyim **hali ham** ichib bo'lmaydigan darajada issiq.

sentences.text: Sarah has **already** visited five countries this year, and it's **still** only June!
sentences.translation: Sara bu yil **allaqachon** beshta davlatda bo'ldi, holbuki **hali** iyun!

sentences.text: The shop opened an hour ago, but there are no customers **yet**.
sentences.translation: Do'kon bir soat oldin ochildi, lekin **hali** birorta xaridor yo'q.

sentences.text: Dad has **already** gone to bed, but Mum is **still** watching TV.
sentences.translation: Dadam **allaqachon** yotib qoldi, oyim esa **hali ham** televizor ko'ryapti.

examples.title: Dialogue: getting ready for a trip
examples.description: Safar oldidan ikki do'st nima tayyor-u nima hali tayyor emasligini tekshiryapti: still, yet, already aralash.

sentences.text: — Bekzod, have you packed **yet**? Our train leaves at six.
sentences.translation: — Bekzod, narsalaringizni **yig'dingizmi**? Poyezdimiz soat oltida jo'naydi.

sentences.text: — Almost. I've **already** packed my clothes and my laptop.
sentences.translation: — Deyarli. Kiyimlarim va noutbukimni **allaqachon** joyladim.

sentences.text: — And the tickets? Have you printed them **yet**?
sentences.translation: — Chiptalar-chi? Ularni **chop etdingizmi**?

sentences.text: — No, not **yet**. The printer **still** isn't working.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **hali** yo'q. Printer **hali ham** ishlamayapti.

sentences.text: — Don't worry, I've **already** got them on my phone.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olmang, ular **allaqachon** telefonimda bor.

sentences.text: — Great! Is your sister **still** coming with us?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Singlingiz **hali ham** biz bilan boradimi?

sentences.text: — Yes, she's **already** on her way to the station.
sentences.translation: — Ha, u **allaqachon** vokzalga yo'lga chiqdi.

sentences.text: — And has your mum made the sandwiches **yet**?
sentences.translation: — Oyingiz sendvichlarni **tayyorladimi**?

sentences.text: — She's **still** making them. She says they'll be ready in five minutes.
sentences.translation: — **Hali ham** tayyorlayapti. Besh daqiqada tayyor bo'ladi, deyapti.

sentences.text: — Perfect. It's **already** four o'clock, so let's call a taxi.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Soat **allaqachon** to'rt bo'ldi, keling, taksi chaqiramiz.
